body: did you know "tolerate it" is in 10/8 time? aaron dessner almost didn't send taylor the piano part — he thought the lopsided meter was too experimental. she wrote to it anyway. and the whole song grew out of a book: du maurier's "rebecca," a husband who merely tolerates a wife trying to please him. track five, naturally.
